core_obligations: Reduce to Y a scheme by etale localness of universal injectivity on the target (proof lines 225-228).
Deduce that f is locally quasi-finite from the assumption that |X x_Y V| -> |V| is injective for every etale V -> Y, using the Decent Spaces criterion (proof lines 229-231).

For a point y with nonempty fibre X_y: the fibre is a scheme locally quasi-finite over kappa(y) with a unique point x, and the same holds after any finite separable extension k/kappa(y) because such extensions are realised etale over Y (proof lines 232-243).
Conclude that X_y is geometrically connected, hence that the finite extension kappa(x)/kappa(y) is purely inseparable, so that f is radicial and therefore universally injective (proof lines 244-255).
proof_roadmap: Etale-local reduction to a scheme base, then local quasi-finiteness from the injectivity hypothesis (proof lines 225-231).
Show the fibre is a one-point scheme that stays one-point after finite separable residue field extension, hence is geometrically connected (proof lines 232-245).
Read off pure inseparability of the residue field extension and conclude radicial, hence universally injective (proof lines 246-255).
difficulty_reason: The criterion takes a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S that is locally of finite type and such that |X x_Y V| -> |V| is injective for every etale V -> Y, and concludes that f is universally injective (statement lines 212-222). The proof is a chain of four reductions: etale-localness on the base, local quasi-finiteness from a Decent Spaces criterion, realisation of finite separable residue field extensions by etale covers of Y, and geometric connectedness of the fibre (proof lines 225-245). The step that needs real content is the fourth: the one-point fibre must be tested after every finite separable extension, which is exactly what the etale realisation lemma buys, and only then does pure inseparability of kappa(x)/kappa(y) follow (proof lines 236-247). The author leaves the final passage from the fibre description to radiciality as a routine check, so H2.
